description: This file defines the LocationDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manage Location entities, including setting related country information and retrieving employee counts for a location.

classes.name: LocationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Location entity, providing additional functionality such as associating countries and counting employees.

methods.name: setLocationService
methods.description: Sets the LocationService for this decorator instance.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Retrieves the LocationService instance, instantiating it if not already set.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Location entity.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Protected method to access the Location entity managed by the decorator.

methods.name: setCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Associates a Country entity (retrieved via code) with the Location.

methods.name: getNoOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the number of employees working at this location.
